text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Haah... haah...
...Ngh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She lost.
Having sprinted all-out the entire way
without holding back once,
her stamina ran dry...
and she was overtaken in the blink of an eye—
a complete defeat.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Running wild—
fury alone will not grant you victory.
Not just against me... but against all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it,
the sun was already setting. Up until now,
I had only ever seen her cheerful side...
I wondered what was going through her mind
right now.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Considering how confident she had been,
this loss had to have
been a major shock.
Or maybe she was just frustrated...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Yeah! What's up?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Had she already accepted the defeat and
processed it? Her unbothered demeanor
surprised me...
but at least this meant we could discuss
the reasons for her loss.
choice_data_list: The reason you lost today was...
The reason you lost today was...

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: It just wasn't my time yet!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to win. I will definitely win!
So this time, I just happened to lose.
choice_data_list: No... that's why we need to analyze—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
No need! I just have to win next time!
I'm sure the Voice of Destiny will say the
same!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
It will! If you keep moving forward,
the scenery changes!
If you just keep charging ahead,
you can even change the world!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
To someone favored by destiny like me,
nothing is impossible!
Tomorrow's me—
will be even stronger than today!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was at a loss for words.
She had genuinely believed she could beat
an elite senior,
only to suffer crushing defeat.
Yet even now,
she hadn't lost an ounce of confidence—
not a shred.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
...Oh! I hear the Voice of Destiny!
Here I goooo!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I thought she was just being dragged
around by gut instinct masquerading as
'destiny.'
I believed that if she ran into bad results,
I'd be able to reason with her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her voice was pure conviction. She truly,
deeply believed in herself.
That unwavering certainty that she was right—
would never be shaken.
choice_data_list: (How am I supposed to guide a girl...
(How am I supposed to guide a girl...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
...Aren't you going to go after Epi-san?

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I refrained from speaking up so as not to
interrupt...
but I was watching over the two of you from
a distance.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Not at all...
Epi-san charges straight ahead once she sets
her mind on something...
I found myself constantly dragged along in
her wake as well.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yet even so...
it's precisely because Epi is who she is
that we want to see her future,
don't you think? ...Look.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Epiphaneia was already out training with
Symboli Kris S,
whom she had just lost to moments ago.
...Or rather—

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
—...*pant*... *pant*...! ...I get it,
if I push in deeper
just like Kris S does...—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Through Kris S's actions,
and through carefully chosen words...
together,
they have guided Epi this far.
Drawn by her destiny.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
When I was reaching out to pre-debut girls
to learn coaching...
Epi stepped forward herself. She said,
'I felt destiny.'

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I was bewildered at first.
But Epi gave her absolute all to keep up
with my training...
and stubbornly fought to stay by Kris S's
side.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Never breaking once...
always believing in herself and charging
ahead.
Smashing through every wall in her path with
incredible momentum...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Yet sooner or later,
she will hit a wall she cannot break.
When that happens,
what she needs is not fellow competitors
like us...
but a guide who can temper that flame.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
And now... you have appeared.
—The one she called destiny herself...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure it isn't one-sided.
You're standing right here
because you felt something too, aren't you,
Trainer? ...Even now.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
If so,
just a little more.
Could you please give it
just a little more thought... about Epi?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—What I feel from Epiphaneia.
Whether it is what she calls
destiny,
I cannot say. But...
it is definitely there.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What I feel from her...
is a 'gravitational pull.' Drawn in by
her potential and boundless energy...
before I knew it,
I was swept up along with her.
choice_data_list: But... things can't go on like this.
But... things can't go on like this.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If I simply let myself be dragged around,
her talent will never truly flourish.
If I cannot properly guide her—
I should step down as her trainer
altogether.
choice_data_list: (I need to set a test for myself—)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
choice_data_list: Kris S, I have a favor to ask.
Kris S, I have a favor to ask.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: ...What?
choice_data_list: Please run a match race against Ep...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If I can guide her before the appointed day
and lead her to victory
against Symboli Kris S—
then I can truly be worthy of being her
trainer.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
......She cannot win.
Do you simply want... an excuse?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her piercing gaze bores right through me.
She must think I want to use
her defeat as an excuse to step down.
But that isn't the real reason.
choice_data_list: I've just decided to believe in th...
I've just decided to believe in th...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
Understood. One month from now.
—Surpass me, if you can.
